title: Pair Sum
description: Given integer nums and target, return the two distinct indices whose values sum to target, in ascending index order. Exactly one pair exists. 2 <= len(nums) <= 10000.

title: Balanced Brackets
description: Return whether s has correctly nested and matched (), [], and {} brackets. s contains only brackets and may be empty. len(s) <= 10000.

title: Merge Sorted Arrays
description: Return a sorted array containing every element of sorted integer arrays a and b, including duplicates. Either may be empty; combined length <= 10000.

title: Best Single Trade
description: Given nonnegative daily prices, return the maximum profit from buying once then selling on a later day. Return 0 if no profitable trade exists. 0 <= len(prices) <= 10000.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a strictly increasing integer array nums and target, return its index or -1 if absent. Use O(log n) time. nums may be empty; length <= 100000.

title: Longest Unique Window
description: Return the length of the longest contiguous substring of s with no repeated characters. s contains ASCII characters; 0 <= len(s) <= 10000.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given closed integer intervals [start,end] with start <= end, merge overlapping or touching intervals and return them ordered by start. 0 <= len(intervals) <= 10000.

title: Island Count
description: Given a rectangular grid of integer 0 (water) and 1 (land), return the number of islands connected horizontally or vertically. An empty grid has zero islands. At most 100 rows and 100 columns.

title: Minimum Coins
description: Given distinct positive integer coin denominations and a nonnegative amount, return the fewest coins needed, or -1 if impossible. Unlimited coins are available. amount <= 10000; 1 <= len(coins) <= 20.

title: Course Feasibility
description: Courses are numbered 0 through num_courses-1. Each prerequisite [a,b] means b must precede a. Return whether all courses can be completed. 1 <= num_courses <= 1000; at most 5000 prerequisite pairs.

title: Tree Level Order
description: Given a binary tree as a level-order array root with null for missing children, return values grouped by level from left to right. Decode children in queue order for non-null nodes. [] is an empty tree; at most 1000 nodes.

title: Kth Largest Element
description: Return the kth largest integer in nums counting duplicate values separately. 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10000.

title: Trapped Rainwater
description: Given nonnegative bar heights of unit width, return the total units of water trapped between bars. 0 <= len(heights) <= 10000.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
description: Return the maximum for each contiguous window of size k in nums, ordered by window start. 1 <= k <= len(nums) <= 10000. Aim for O(n) time.

title: Edit Distance
description: Return the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, and substitutions needed to transform source into target. Both strings contain lowercase English letters and have length <= 500.
